description: Yoga cancellation (Yoga Bhanga) rules for Vedic astrology. Defines conditions under which yogas are cancelled, partially weakened, or fully negated.

pancha_mahapurusha.description: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas (Hamsa, Malavya, Ruchaka, Bhadra, Sasa) are cancelled when the forming planet is combust or loses a planetary war.

raja_yoga.description: Raja Yoga cancelled when forming planets are debilitated or in 6/8/12 from each other.

conditions.description: Forming planet debilitated without Neecha Bhanga
Forming planets in 6/8/12 from each other

dhana_yoga.description: Dhana Yoga cancelled when 2nd/11th lords are afflicted by malefics.

gajakesari.description: Gajakesari Yoga cancelled when Moon or Jupiter in dusthana (6/8/12) from Lagna.

conditions.description: Moon or Jupiter in 6th, 8th, or 12th house
Moon or Jupiter debilitated without Neecha Bhanga

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.description: Neecha Bhanga itself is cancelled if the debilitated planet is also combust.

conditions.description: Debilitated planet with Neecha Bhanga is also combust - cancellation of cancellation

general_cancellation_conditions.description: Planet within combustion orb of Sun
Planet in debilitation sign without cancellation
Conjunct 2 or more malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu)
Planet lost in Graha Yuddha (within 1 degree)
